notes.title: Mushy end of life announcement
notes.content:
Hey Guys.

Let me start off by saying that the support towards mushy has been absolutely incredible. The game has amassed almost 150,000 downloads since it came out.

Some of you might know this already but game development isn't my full time gig. I'm mainly a youtuber and this game was made in around a month to show off to my audience - I never expected it to get this big.

Anyway enough about me.

I promised a few months ago that "within the next few weeks" I would update mushy to add cosmetics. Unfortunately, due to having to keep uploading videos as well as finish up my exams I've had almost no time to do this. 

I've just finished my exams and so I'm keen to come back and complete this update as I don't want to start my career on empty promises. I won't give you a time frame just yet, but I'm hoping I can document this endeavor over on my second channel and so It should give me a little more motivation to get things done.

I also have a new steam game releasing soon that's actually good - shocker.

Anyway, it goes without saying that this will be the final mushy update ever. If there's any remaining bugs that you wish to be fixed then leave them down below and I'll try my best to fix as many as I can.

Cheers,
Barji

notes.title: Update on Mushy Customisation + New Game :)
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

I promised that when my youtube channel reached 75,000 subscribers I would release an update to mushy that included cosmetics - [i]I think I may have been a little bit ambitious with that deadline[/i].

I feel guilty for not delivering on my promise, I don't want to be known as the game developer who makes pie-crust promises and doesn't deliver. So I assure you at some point within the next few months I'll spend a couple of days on mushy to add these cosmetics. I know this is going to be disappointing for many. Mushy far exceeded all expectations and I have nothing but gratitude.

Onto other news! I have made a new steam game (Irony is a bitch)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428870/Grapple/

It's called grapple, it's a speedrunning-parkour game, if you want to try it out it's free!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content: Thank you for all the positive support! As promised, I have reached 75,000 subscribers and will be releasing mushy cosmetics free of charge! You can expect this within the next couple of weeks :)

notes.title: Future of Mushy V 2.3.0
notes.content:
As many of you may know, I made this game specifically for my YouTube channel. Since releasing the video the game has amassed over 70,000 downloads and has been on new and trending.

I never intended to even update the game but I feel it is my duty to at least somewhat give the players what they want.

In an effort to do so, I will be adding one final big update to mushy (V3.0.0) which will fix all existing major bugs as well as add Customisations for your shrigmas, similar to the mushystache.

I'll release the bugfixes periodically up until V 3.0.0. However I'm only launching the customisation update when my Youtube Channel hits 75,000 subscribers ;)

[previewyoutube=M_UPj2j6gvU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

V 2.3.0

-Fixed footsteps from being heard all around the map.
-Re-added bloom as I accidentally removed it last update (whoops)
-Added Mushystache for MacOS users.

Cheers :)

notes.title: Mushy V1.3.0
notes.content:
- Fixed Sniper Scope not having long enough range
- Added new items in main menu
- Changed main menu links
- Fixed a bug where connecting to an invalid lobby id of the correct format would cause a black start button to appear and a crash.
- The winning team is now awarded $2000 when they win, and the losing team is rewarded $1000. Players who die will be awarded $500 seeing as they just lost their guns :(
- Gave myself golden shrigma male because Idgaf

notes.title: Mushy Bugfix 1.2.0
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where disconnecting players would crash the server
- Fixed a bug where trying to switch spectated player wouldn’t work
- Improved Game Visuals (I never realised they weren’t being applied in game whoops lol)
- Removed Linux Build (This is due to people complaining that they wouldn’t work, managing two platforms is enough of a challenge. You can still play it through Proton)
- Added Versioning System (can’t join games on different versions)

notes.title: Mushy Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
🍄Mushy Version: 1.1.0
-Fixed Players being visible under the map.
-Server should be more reliable kicking players when alt+f4 or using red X.
-If you were the bomb holder and then you kill the other team without planting then you would keep the bomb and another one would still be assigned. This is now fixed.
-Can no longer spectate dead players
-A bug involving the timer going below 0 and the game not ending when the bomb was planted and all attackers were dead has now been fixed.
-Added resolution settings and defaulted game to Fullscreen
-You can no longer "reload" the bomb
-Added a Linux build
-added a defuse kit lol
(MAKE SURE TO VERIFY AND CHECK YOU HAVE THE RIGHT VERSION)
